items.title: Jonathan Bailey's breathy Dracula audiobook clip sends fans feral
items.summary: Entertainment Tonight shared a behind-the-scenes clip of Jonathan Bailey and Ella Purnell recording a feeding scene for Audible's new Bram Stoker's Dracula, with heavy breathing, a hand on his chest and Purnell biting an apple for the sound effect. The clip split viewers between thirst and second-hand embarrassment, and posts asking whether audiobooks were their new kink spread across X and TikTok.
items.author: @thoseanimegirlz

items.title: Eminem fans revolt over his feature on Kid Rock's Christian album
items.summary: Kid Rock posted the tracklist for his Christian album Halfway to Jesus, revealing Eminem on a song called "7 Sins" and framing it as proof friends can differ politically. Fans who remembered Eminem's 2017 line-in-the-sand against Trump supporters called the collab spineless, questioned whether it was real until his camp confirmed it, and posted about deleting his songs.
items.author: @KidRock
